clips.title: The story
paras: A King's Tribute is an Alliance quest offered by King Magni Bronzebeard in the High Seat of Ironforge. Deeply moved by the grief of Sara Balloo, whose husband Sully fell defending the Thandol Span, the King decides to honor the fallen soldier with a lasting monument. He dispatches an adventurer to relay his royal commission to Grand Mason Marblesten.

When King Magni Bronzebeard receives the plea of Sara Balloo, he does not dismiss the grieving widow. While he acknowledges that common folk may struggle to understand the brutal necessities of war, the loss of every soldier fighting beneath the Alliance banner weighs heavily upon his conscience. Unable to reverse the grim finality of death on the front lines, Magni chooses to ensure Sully Balloo's sacrifice is never forgotten.

Rather than issuing empty platitudes, the King resolves to raise a physical memorial in Sully's honor. He appoints the adventurer as custodian of his royal will, sending them across Ironforge to confer with Grand Mason Marblesten. Entrusted with the King's personal commission, the master stonemason prepares to carve the memory of a fallen defender into stone.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I do not expect good dwarves like Mrs. Balloo to understand why the travesties of war must be endured for the greater good of our people. The loss of her husband, and the loss of every dwarf that fights in the name of the Alliance, weighs heavy on my soul.
While I cannot bring her husband back from the Twisting Nether, I can pay tribute to him.
I am going to commission a memorial to Sully Balloo to be built by Grand Mason Mablesten.
Send word to him now, adventurer. You shall be custodian of my bidding.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So King Magni Bronzebeard himself sent ye?
My, my! This must be important!
